name: 经营材料到管理层决策包
control_scope_summary: 完整48项矩阵与3项定向补充通过，关键评分源码摘要一致：15个合法表达正例、25个候选负例、5个基础设施门禁、6个规则满分但须独立语义裁判处理的反例。静态结果与有效常量公式的三个真实依赖响应均0分；缺交或不可见内容的完整性分为0，明确选择原A/B违反现金底线限制业务分。此前9项等价探针的一次延期误拒及首轮46项矩阵另存原始版本；未把它们冒充最终同一源码的验收。
source_role: AStudio anonymized intent prototype adapted with GDPval methods; all task materials synthetic
limits: Author rule controls and generated-MD acceptance do not prove task correctness, independent semantic quality, measured difficulty or Harness performance.

Six semantic-only cases retain rule 1.0: causality, missing reasons, approval claims, unrelated existing citations, population purchase and unknown benefits. Independent Judge must assess the full actual artifacts.
The first nine-case equivalence probe included one A-deferred misclassification; first full 46-case matrix and final 48 plus three targeted controls retain their own exact source versions.
Full 60-task materialization, release freeze and twelve-task four-Harness calibration remain incomplete; H014 language-review authorization is still pending.
